description: Defines functions and classes for efficient lookup of strings in a fixed set using a DAFSA (Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton). Includes external references to string handling and export macros, and defines a class for incremental prefix/suffix matching.

classes.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
classes.description: Provides incremental, space-efficient membership and prefix queries against a fixed set of strings represented as a DAFSA.

methods.name: LookupStringInFixedSet
methods.description: Performs a fast lookup to determine if a string is in a fixed set, returning a status code or bitmap of rules.

methods.name: LookupSuffixInReversedSet
methods.description: Finds the longest matching suffix in a reversed DAFSA for a given host.

methods.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the incremental lookup with a DAFSA graph.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current prefix match with an additional character.

methods.name: GetResultForCurrentSequence
methods.description: Returns the match result code for the current prefix.
